scenario.organization_context: National distribution company, 600 workers. Operations supervisors manage inventory access through SAP ERP portals.

simulation.subject: ACTION REQUIRED: Verify Your Operations SAP Portal Account Access
simulation.body:
Dear Operations Supervisor,

As part of our ongoing quarterly security compliance audit for all regional supply chain and distribution hubs, all active SAP ERP portal accounts used for inventory management require immediate verification.

Failure to complete this mandatory verification within 48 hours will result in a temporary suspension of your inventory access credentials to prevent potential compliance violations.

Please proceed to the internal compliance portal to confirm your credentials and active warehouse ID:

[SIMULATED LINK: Access SAP Verification Portal at https://sap-verify.logi-sync-sim.local/auth]

Thank you for your prompt attention to this matter to ensure uninterrupted warehouse operations.

Regards,

Central ERP Compliance Committee
Apex Logistics Network

metadata.difficulty_rationale: Difficulty level 2 is achieved by using an unresolvable lookalike sender domain and a general sense of urgency regarding account suspension, which is noticeable upon closer inspection.
metadata.scenario_notes: Tailored for operations supervisors dealing with inventory access.
